welcome.subject: Welcome to WhyNot QA
welcome.body: Welcome to WhyNot QA! Your account is ready.
resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: Click the link below to reset your password.
verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email address
verifyEmail.body: Please verify your email address by clicking the link below.
invoice.subject: Your invoice from WhyNot QA
billing.trialStarted.subject: Your trial has started
billing.trialStarted.body: Your {{plan}} trial is active. It expires on {{trialEnd}}.
billing.trialExpiring.subject: Your trial is expiring soon
billing.trialExpiring.body: Your trial expires on {{trialEnd}}. Upgrade now to keep your access.
billing.paymentFailed.subject: Payment failed
billing.paymentFailed.body: We were unable to process your payment. Please update your payment method.
billing.subscriptionUpgraded.subject: Subscription upgraded
billing.subscriptionUpgraded.body: Your subscription has been upgraded to {{plan}}.
billing.subscriptionDowngraded.subject: Subscription downgraded
billing.subscriptionDowngraded.body: Your subscription will change to {{plan}} at the end of the current period.
billing.paymentSuccess.subject: Payment received
billing.paymentSuccess.body: We received your payment of {{amount}} for {{plan}}. Thank you!
billing.subscriptionCreated.subject: Welcome to {{plan}}
billing.subscriptionCreated.body: Your {{plan}} subscription is now active. Start exploring your new features.
billing.renewalReminder.subject: Subscription renewal reminder
billing.renewalReminder.body: Your {{plan}} subscription will renew on {{renewalDate}} for {{amount}}.
billing.trialEnding.subject: Your trial ends in {{daysRemaining}} days
billing.trialEnding.body: Your {{plan}} trial expires on {{trialEnd}}. Upgrade now to keep your access and data.
billing.creditsLow.subject: Your credits are running low
billing.creditsLow.body: Your credit balance is {{currentBalance}}, below the {{threshold}} threshold. Top up to avoid service interruption.
notification.footer: You're receiving this because you have notifications enabled in WhyNot.
notification.scanComplete.subject: Scan complete: {{projectName}}
notification.scanComplete.heading: Scan Complete
notification.scanComplete.body: Your QA scan for {{projectName}} has finished.
notification.criticalBug.subject: Critical bug found in {{projectName}}
notification.criticalBug.heading: Critical Bug Found
notification.criticalBug.body: A {{severity}} severity bug was found in {{projectName}}.
notification.monitorAlert.subject: Monitor alert: {{monitorName}}
notification.monitorAlert.heading: Monitor Alert
notification.autoFixPr.subject: Auto-fix PR created for {{projectName}}
notification.autoFixPr.heading: Auto-Fix PR Ready
notification.autoFixPr.body: A pull request has been created to fix {{bugTitle}} in {{projectName}}.
notification.passwordReset.heading: Password Reset
notification.passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to choose a new one.
notification.passwordReset.expiry: This link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.
